Both direct and constrained gestures reuse the existing `_v1018Dragging` / Stage-C transform observer so Core remains the durable transform authority. Exact implementation head `69788871b7f68d6ad14f705e22e9bdb987901d54`; full build/package run `34750856469` is green.
+- verification_state: packaged reference-machine retest required; confirm direct Move drag, axis-constrained Move/Scale, visible ring rotation, and save/reopen transform persistence all behave correctly
 - desired_state: intuitive direct model drag where appropriate plus axis constraints; rotation exposes visible rotation rings/circles while retaining precise axis manipulation
